parameters.query:
SELECT id AS company_id, slug, ats::text AS ats, name AS company, hq, size, stage, linkedin_slug, careers_url
FROM companies
WHERE status = 'active'
ORDER BY id

SELECT (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AS id,
       COALESCE(array_agg(lower(keyword)), '{}') AS ignored_keywords
FROM ignored_keywords

UPDATE jobs
SET closed_at = CURRENT_DATE
WHERE closed_at IS NULL
  AND last_seen_at < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
